name: Jakubov u Moravských Budějovic (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a red lower hoist part and a white upper fly part, with a scallop shell counterchanged over the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 June 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
